slides.scene: Aachu stands near a simple mirror, fixing one earring, but her eyes meet Zuv through the reflection. Zuv is at the doorway, half caught smiling. Keep both faces readable; do not make Aachu pose like a model.
slides.text:
Yeh adaayein kahan se laati ho?
Main har baar phas jaata hoon.

slides.scene: At the doorway, Aachu lightly fixes Zuv's already-perfect collar with serious pretend focus. Her other hand gently holds his wrist so he cannot leave yet. Zuv looks down at the collar, amused because he knows the excuse.
slides.text:
Collar toh theek hi tha.
Bahana tumhara tha.

slides.scene: Post-fight night scene on sofa or bed edge. Aachu looks away with a small annoyed face while still placing a glass of water near Zuv or pulling a blanket toward his shoulder. Zuv watches quietly.
slides.text:
Muh phula ke bhi
meri fikr kar leti ho.

slides.scene: Terrace at night. Aachu rests her head on Zuv's shoulder as if nothing happened. Zuv's hand is frozen mid-air above her hair, smiling softly because he has no defense left.
slides.text:
Jab laad aata hai na,
mujhe kuch samajh nahi aata.
